QuestInfo.name: Doodles of the Past
QuestInfo.0: The doodles are about your old hideout from when you were a kid! It's a place that fills with starlight at night.
QuestInfo.1: The doodles point towards your old hideout in the #bPath to Downtown#k. Search the #bOld Box#k you found.
QuestInfo.2: A gift and a letter that you never got to deliver were inside the box. Feelings that you thought were long dead are beginning to stir within you...

0.0: I made these doodles when I was a kid! I can't believe they're still here...\r\n
0.1: This place was my secret tunnel out into the real world. I used to run and hide here when I got into trouble...\r\n
0.2: But why were they left up? Did someone want me to find it? I should take a look around.\r\n

yes.0: Writing codes on the wall. Secret hideouts. I guess I've always been up to no good...\r\n
yes.1: The entrance should be just past this rock. I wonder if the old place has changed much...

no.0: No. No, this probably isn't the place...\r\n

1.0: #b(It's an old chest filled with the treasures of your youth. Memories flood back as you go through its contents.)#k\r\n

0.msg: Heh... It's all my old stuff. My slingshot, my old wooden sword... I used to practice for hours with this.\r\n

1.msg: I thought I was so tough back then. Ha... What a brat I was.

2.msg: ...What's this? A bouquet... and a letter? These aren't mine...\r\n

3.msg: To... mother? I was going to surprise her with this. The day before... it happened...\r\n

4.msg: #b(Even after all these years, the scent of the flower fills the box.)#k\r\n

5.msg: ...N-no. No more looking back. I promised myself I'd only look forward from now on...\r\n

6.msg: I need to get out of here. There's still more work to do!\r\n

default.0: It's almost as if this place wanted to be found... I should go inside.\r\n
